sentences.en: My wrath shall far exceed the love I ever bore.
sentences.zh: 我的愤怒将远远超过我曾经给予的爱。

sentences.en: The load exceeded the maximum allowed, and the server crashed.
sentences.zh: 负载超过了最大允许值，服务器崩溃了。

sentences.en: An income tax is levied on any income that exceeds deductions.
sentences.zh: 对任何超出扣除额的收入征收所得税。
